name: Grade 7 IT Practice: April Week 7 - Feedback Signals
description: Practice words for lights, sound, and robot state signals.

words.definition: A programmed robot light used as a feedback signal.
words.example: The LED turned on when the robot reached the checkpoint.

words.definition: A part that makes a sound.
words.example: The buzzer sounded after the robot completed the route.
The robot state changed from moving to stopped.

words.definition: Something that starts an action in a program.
words.example: Touching the sensor was the event that started the sound.

words.definition: A sign or message sent to show information.
words.example: The blinking light was a signal that the robot was ready.

words.definition: A repeated light or sound signal that communicates robot status.
words.example: The LED pattern blinked twice before the robot moved.
